text_block_list.text:
Having won the autumn Tenno Sho,
Mayano Top
Gun has grown into a racer
who truly makes her
fans roar with
excitement.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A few days later while training, she spies
Narita
Brian partner running with
Симболи Рудольф.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With the image of Нарита Брайан shining
brightly in
her mind, she vows to give it
her all at the Arima
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
